paragraphs.source_en: Despite this gloom, the elections also showed the continuing commitment of young Iranians (despite previous indications of nihilism and despair) to the principles of justice and constitutional government, in an Iranian Islamic context, that their predecessors had been struggling for since 1906. There is no reason to think that they are going to give up on those principles. The even longer history of the profound Iranian distaste for unjust and oppressive rulers, some of which has been traced in this book, gives hope that they will ultimately prevail. 0465019205-text_Layout 1 12/28/09 5:49 PM Page 302 0465019205-text_Layout 1 12/28/09 5:49 PM Page 303
